### Added

* **Prowlarr, Uptime Kuma, Cloudflare Tunnel, Peanut (UPS)** — app card integrations with dashboard widgets and Add/Edit modal help
* **Per-app CPU/RAM toggle** — hide container metrics on individual app cards (Add/Edit App)
* **Host telemetry mapping** — Settings → Privacy & Access: pick external/internal network interfaces and disk mount points for agent stats
* **Guest ONLINE/OFFLINE** — sanitized container status for guest view (no RUNNING/STOPPED noise)
* **Login page branding** — theme logo and custom CSS on the sign-in screen

### Improved

* **AdGuard Home** — form labels Basic auth (not API key); auto-encodes raw `username:password`; reads `num_blocked_filtering`; safer integration fetch error handling
* **Unraid docs** — appdata permission fix (`chown`) and Docker password reset steps
* **GitHub Issues** — preferred channel for bugs and feature requests (docs + README)

### Install / Upgrade

Proxmox / bare metal:

```bash
curl -sSL https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/releases/latest/download/update-amud.sh | bash
```

Docker / Unraid: pull latest image and restart **AMUD-Dashboard** and **AMUD-Agent**.

Hard-refresh the dashboard (`Ctrl+Shift+R`) after upgrade. **Settings → System** should show `v1.5.5.0`.
